title: LayerRAG-Bench：面向Agentic检索增强生成的跨层可靠性基准
summary: LayerRAG-Bench是一个跨层可靠性基准，覆盖8个企业领域、240个任务、9种故障场景和2种契约模式，包含38,880条记录，评估9个模型。研究发现模式规范化可提升schema漂移成功率，但无法修复陈旧证据、缺失工具输出、权限拒绝和错误会话上下文。支持按层评估原则，避免将特定修复误认为通用方案。
summary_en: LayerRAG-Bench is a cross-layer reliability benchmark for agentic RAG, covering 8 enterprise domains, 240 tasks, 9 fault scenarios, and 38,880 records across 9 models. Schema normalization improves schema-drift success but fails on stale evidence, missing tool output, denied permissions, and wrong-session context, supporting layer-specific evaluation.
